title: 第566章 超香宫亲王第565章 叶开再演大四喜
content_zh:
苏小天来到叶开面前，谄媚地说，“老大，你这次表现太棒了，震动了东瀛皇室，一位亲王要请您吃饭。”
叶开看了看苏小天身后的几个东瀛人，目光锐利，太阳穴高高鼓起，显然都是高手。
“亲王？我不去！”
“老大，你去吧，就当是给我帮忙了。”
“要去你自己去，我累了，要休息。”
“老大呀，你有所不知，这个亲王是东瀛最有权势的超香宫亲王。
就连天皇都要看他的脸色，你不去，他肯定会找我的麻烦，说不定我这条小命就要撂在这里了。”
“他敢动你？”
“有什么不敢的，恐怕我们整个球队都要跟着倒霉。”
“法不治众，他能对我们球队下手？”
“能啊，去年有一支东瀛球队参加了一场世界大赛，成绩很差。
亲王大怒，把领队毙掉，所有球员都揍了一顿！”
苏小天添油加醋地说着。
“我去，太狠毒了吧。”
“是啊，老大，你就看在这些球员们的面子上，去一次吧。”
叶开勉为其难地答应了，“好吧，在哪里？”
“亲王家里，他设下了家宴欢迎你。”
“走，我们过去。”
两人走出酒店，上了一辆豪车，福田至尊，七百多万一辆。
后边跟着六辆车，组成了一个浩浩荡荡的车队，来到一座富丽堂皇的王宫前。

门口有侍者在等待，叶开和苏小天下车后，侍者引着两人走进王宫，来到一楼餐厅。
两人在餐桌旁坐下，过了一会儿，一名老年男子挽着一个女子出现了。
这名男子就是超香宫亲王，面相凶狠，嘴唇上留着仁丹胡。
当叶开看到超香宫亲王身边的女人时，不禁一愣。
这个女人特别像奈川岛上的那个女人，但是她今晚打扮的雍容华贵，气度非凡，头上还带着王后金冠，叶开不敢确定她是不是岛上的女人。
超香宫亲王在主位坐下，王后坐在他旁边。
苏小天赶紧介绍，“亲王陛下您好，这位就是高中峰先生。”
超香宫亲王看了看叶开，点点头，“果然很帅，身材也很好，球还踢得那么好，真是难得的人才啊！”
菜上来了，都是东瀛料理，还上了一瓶清酒。
“来，高先生，为你接风。”超香宫亲王举起了酒杯。
叶开举杯示意了一下，轻轻品了一口。
超香宫亲王放下酒杯，“高先生有没有考虑过到帝京来发展？”
叶开摇摇头，“没有，我不想出国。”
“高先生不要急着做决定，可以慢慢考虑考虑，这些年我们东瀛的足球发展的很快，已经远远超过了大夏。
我们的几家俱乐部都很有实力，和鹰超大俱乐部关系很好，可以帮助你成为国际巨星。”
叶开淡淡地说，“谢谢亲王的好意，我暂时还没有这个想法。”
“不着急，等你想通了再跟我联系，我来帮你运作。”
超香宫亲王看向苏小天，“苏总，你可以劝一劝高先生，他现在的年龄是去鹰超踢球的最佳时机，错过了很可惜的。”
苏小天讨好地说，“亲王爱才，一切都为球员的前途着想，我们回去以后一定慎重考虑。”
content_en:
Su Xiaotian came to Ye Kai and said flatteringly, "Boss, your performance this time was great. It shocked the Japanese royal family. A prince wants to treat you to dinner."
Ye Kai looked at the Japanese people behind Su Xiaotian. Their eyes were sharp and their temples were bulging high. They were obviously masters.
"Prince? I won't go!"
"Boss, go ahead and think of it as helping me."
"You have to go by yourself. I'm tired and need to rest."
"Boss, you don't know something. This prince is the most powerful Prince of Chaoxiang Palace in Japan.
Even the emperor will look at his face. If you don't go, he will definitely cause trouble for me, and maybe my little life will be lost here. "
"He dares to touch you?"
"If you don't dare, I'm afraid our entire team will be in trouble."
"The law does not rule the masses, can he attack our team?"
"Yes, last year a Japanese team participated in a World Series and did very poorly.
The prince was furious, killed the team leader, and beat up all the players! "
Su Xiaotian said embellished.
"I'll go, it's too cruel."
"Yes, boss, just for the sake of these players, go there once."
Ye Kai reluctantly agreed, "Okay, where?"
"At the prince's house, he has set up a family banquet to welcome you."
"Come on, let's go there."
The two walked out of the hotel and got into a luxury car, Foton Supreme, which cost more than seven million yuan.
Followed by six cars, they formed a mighty motorcade and arrived in front of a magnificent palace.
There was a waiter waiting at the door. After Ye Kai and Su Xiaotian got off the car, the waiter led them into the palace and to the restaurant on the first floor.
The two sat down at the dining table. After a while, an elderly man appeared with a woman on his arm.
This man is Prince Chaoxiang Palace, with a fierce face and a beard on his lips.
When Ye Kai saw the woman next to Prince Chaoxiang Palace, he couldn't help but be stunned.
This woman looked particularly like the woman on Nagawa Island, but she was dressed elegantly and elegantly tonight, with a queen's golden crown on her head. Ye Kai was not sure if she was the woman on the island.
Prince Chaoxiang Palace sat down at the main seat, and the Queen sat next to him.
Su Xiaotian quickly introduced, "Hello, Your Majesty, this is Mr. Gao Feng."
Prince Chaoxiang Palace looked at Ye Kai and nodded, "He is indeed handsome, has a good figure, and can play football so well. He is such a rare talent!"
The dishes arrived, all Japanese cuisine, and a bottle of sake was also served.
"Come, Mr. Gao, I'll catch the wind for you." Prince Chaoxiang Palace raised his wine glass.
Ye Kai raised his glass and took a sip.
Prince Chaoxiang Palace put down his wine glass and asked, "Has Mr. Gao ever considered developing in the Imperial Capital?"
Ye Kai shook his head, "No, I don't want to go abroad."
"Mr. Gao, don't make a decision in a hurry. You can think about it slowly. Our football in Japan has developed very fast in recent years, and it has far surpassed that of Daxia.
Several of our clubs are very powerful and have a good relationship with the Eagle Super Club, which can help you become an international superstar. "
Ye Kai said calmly, "Thank you, Prince, for your kindness. I don't have this idea yet."
"Don't worry, contact me when you figure it out, and I'll help you run it."
Prince Chaoxiang Palace looked at Su Xiaotian, "Mr. Su, you can advise Mr. Gao that his current age is the best time to go to the Eagle Super League to play football. It would be a pity to miss it."
Su Xiaotian said flatteringly, "The prince loves talents and everything is for the future of the players. We will consider it carefully after we return."
